fields.summary_ko.0: Meta (META) trades at a forward PER of 18.78x, cheaper than Amazon's 23.39x and Microsoft's 24.20x, but YTD return of -5.1% trails the technology sector's +6.9% gain: Q3 capital expenditures of $34.91B represent an 80% increase from prior year's $19.37B.
fields.summary_ko.1: Meta's Q3 operating profit declined YoY by 37% to $12.99B, with operating margin compressing from 40% to 20%: costs and expenditures increased 68%, far exceeding the 26% revenue growth, pressuring net profit.
